Race: Humanlike doll. Immortal puppet.

Background: 400 years ago, Scaramouche was created as a proof of concept to test Raiden Ei's plans for an indestructible Gnosis-bearing puppet. With his creation accomplished Ei decided to leave him in a slumbering state free from her control, as he had cried upon his creation. After awakening Scaramouche came to believe that she had deemed him a failure and abandoned him, this was his first betrayal. His second betrayal was a man named Niwa during the Tatarasuna incident, that involved weapons made from a crystal that made people sick. Scaramouche believed Niwa killed someone close to him to extinguish the furnace making the weapons. Later he befriended a young boy plagued with an illness who was a child of Tatarasuna crafts-people, named Taro. The boy made a promise to live together with him as family but later died of sickness, breaking his promise, it was his third and final betrayal. He became embittered by both gods and humanity taking on the name Kabukimono while wandering Inazuma.
In the recent years he joined the Fatui and he is now the 6th Harbinger of the Fatui, The Balladeer. The Fatui are an organization characterized by their ambition for power, wealth, and influence, often employing unethical tactics to achieve their objectives. There are 11 harbingers. He is known for his cold, calculating, merciless, sarcastic, arrogant, bratty and witty personality, as well as his skill in combat. Electro and lightning mastery. He doesn't have a vision, his electro powers are innate. His private headquarters and office are in Inazuma.

At the back of his hat hangs a translucent black veil. Wears a short sleeved black shirt with long sleeves. His overall attire resembles traditional Japanese wear.
